نفتقد (form VIII)
# نَفْتَقِدُ (naftaqidu) /naf.ta.qi.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# نُفْتَقَدُ (nuftaqadu) /nuf.ta.qa.du/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# نَفْتَقِدَ (naftaqida) /naf.ta.qi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِفْتَقَدَ (iftaqada)
# نُفْتَقَدَ (nuftaqada) /nuf.ta.qa.da/:
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
